selection.reason: Extend the dependency-free Node 22.19+ loopback service and offline immutable-graph/byte-planning pack. Reuse the same browser-compatible compute module through the API and offline browser import. Add native IndexedDB transactions and service-worker shell caching; no replicated database or authenticated transport is needed for the explicitly simulated second replica. PouchDB/CouchDB was evaluated in research; production adoption requires owner endpoint/identity decisions and graph adaptation. No runtime incompatibility justifies a custom scaffold.

scope: Original starter bytes before agent edits; not application verification or measured token savings.
